subject: Update dual channel replication conf to mention the local buffer is imited by COB (#2824)
reason: The change only rewords a log message in bufferReplData to include the configured byte limit, updates the test's log-matching pattern accordingly, and adds a documentation comment to valkey.conf. No executable behaviour changes: the dual-channel buffering cutoff logic, its condition, and its effect are untouched, so there is nothing a fuzzer scenario could distinguish between the two builds.
